fluff.overview: Clan jump Points equip five warriors with personal jump packs for vertical mobility across broken terrain. Jump-capable Points offer Clan garrison commanders a flexible response element that can access elevated positions, clear multi-story structures, and exploit terrain features that foot infantry cannot reach. Within the Touman, jump-qualified warriors carry marginally more prestige than standard foot garrison troops, though conventional infantry of any type remains far below BattleMech and battle armor assignments in the warrior caste hierarchy.
